rh.code_paper_alignment.methodology_matc.reason: The total-gradient variance procedure materially differs from the reported procedure. The paper says both metrics use a 32-probe oracle and bootstrap intervals. The total-gradient implementation draws one probe per molecule, centers both estimators on the sample mean of PHL gradients, and computes no bootstrap intervals. This is affirmative methodological contradiction, independent of whether its numerical ratios are scientifically useful.
